name: Patient Flow Coordination
description: Manages the check-in and check-out processes smoothly, ensuring patients move efficiently through the front office. Adjusts to real-time changes in patient arrivals and departures to maintain an organized flow and minimize waiting times.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in keeping families moving smoothly through reception?”
friendly_description: You are the conductor of the front office! By keeping check-ins and check-outs smooth, you ensure every patient feels cared for and no one is left waiting.

name: Clinical Team Communication
description: Proactively shares relevant patient information with the clinical team. Ensures that any special requests, concerns, or observations made at the front desk are communicated to the clinical staff to support excellent and timely patient care.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in passing important patient info to the clinical team quickly and clearly?”
friendly_description: You are the bridge between the front and the back. Passing critical info to the clinical team instantly ensures they are ready to give the best care possible.

name: Daily Schedule Adaptability
description: Effectively responds to same-day scheduling changes, such as cancellations, same-day treatment, late arrivals, or walk-ins. Adjusts appointments promptly to accommodate these changes, maintaining an efficient schedule and minimizing disruptions to patient care.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in reshuffling the day’s schedule when cancellations or walk-ins occur?”
friendly_description: Schedules change, but you stay cool! Your ability to adapt to cancellations and walk-ins keeps the team productive and ensures patients get seen.

name: Fundamental Dental Knowledge
description: Possesses basic knowledge of common dental procedures, including their typical duration, procedure code, preparation steps, and comfort considerations. Provides patients with general information and answers common questions, directing more complex inquiries to clinical staff when necessary.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you giving parents a basic explanation of routine procedures?”
tagline: Know your dental codes and procedures
friendly_description: You speak the language of dentistry. Knowing your codes and procedures builds confidence with patients and makes you a huge asset to the clinical team.

name: Patient Record Maintenance
description: Keeps all patient records up-to-date and accurate, including treatments, notes, medical history, consents, referal documentation, and insurance/financial documents. Ensures that all records the front desk handles are meticulously maintained for seamless patient care and compliance.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you that patient records you handle stay 100 % accurate and up-to-date?”
friendly_description: Great care starts with great data. Your meticulous attention to patient records ensures nothing gets missed and every visit is safe and seamless.

name: Communication Balancing
description: Skillfully balances various communication demands throughout the day, consistently managing in-person greetings, incoming calls, emails, and messages. Maintains smooth operations even during high-traffic times by prioritizing tasks and providing attentive service to patients and team members.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you juggling calls, in-person guests, and messages all at once?”
friendly_description: You are the master of multitasking. Balancing phones, emails, and smiles means every patient feels heard and the practice never misses a beat.

name: Strategic Scheduling
description: Utilizes all available resources to construct and maintain an optimal schedule that maximizes productivity and allocates dentist time effectively. Ensures appointments are scheduled to meet clinic goals and patient needs, contributing to the practice's overall efficiency and success.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in building a productive schedule that maximizes dentist time?”
friendly_description: You don't just fill slots; you orchestrate the day. A strategically built schedule maximizes our impact and ensures the team works efficiently.

name: Welcoming Environment
description: Maintains a clean, organized, and inviting front desk and reception area. Ensures supplies are stocked, spaces are tidy, and the environment is comfortable, creating a positive first impression for patients.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in maintaining a tidy, stocked, and welcoming reception area?”
friendly_description: First impressions happen here. By keeping the reception area welcoming and organized, you tell every patient, "We care about excellence."

name: Welcoming Presence
description: Consistently maintains a positive, calm, and welcoming demeanor, providing a reassuring and confident presence for patients both in person and over the phone. Enhances the patient experience by making everyone feel comfortable and valued from the moment they arrive.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you keeping a calm, positive tone with every family?”
friendly_description: You are the warmth of the practice. Your calm, welcoming presence can turn a nervous patient into a relaxed one the moment they walk in.

name: Empathetic Practice Policy Education
description: Effectively communicates and enforces practice policies in a firm yet empathetic manner. Educates patients on requirements such as timely arrival to appointments, cancellation guidelines, paperwork completion, and rescheduling without causing frustration or anger, ensuring understanding and cooperation.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in enforcing policies firmly yet empathetically?”
tagline: Strict policies delivered with a soft hand
friendly_description: You handle tough conversations with grace. Educating patients on policies without losing the connection is a superpower that builds long-term respect.

name: Trust Building Interactions
description: Builds genuine connections with patients through personalized interactions. Makes patients feel known and appreciated by referencing personal details and addressing their individual needs while maintaining professionalism
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you creating personal connections that make patients feel valued?”
friendly_description: You make people feel known, not just treated. Remembering the little details builds a bond that turns patients into raving fans.

name: Handling Critical Feedback
description: Responds to patient complaints or negative feedback calmly and professionally. Addresses concerns appropriately, seeking mutually beneficial solutions to enhance patient satisfaction and improve practice services.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in calmly resolving complaints or negative feedback?”
friendly_description: Feedback is an opportunity, and you handle it like a pro. Turning a complaint into a solution shows maturity and deep care for the patient experience.

name: Effective Objection Handling
description: Actively works to prevent cancellations and unnecessary appointment rescheduling by addressing patient concerns promptly and effectively. Proactively fills open appointment slots to maintain an efficient schedule. When encountering objections or questions beyond their scope, promptly refers patients to the appropriate team member, such as the treatment coordinator, office manager, or dentist.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in preventing cancellations by addressing parent concerns?”
tagline: ABC: Always Be Closing - Adapt and overcome
friendly_description: You are a champion for their health. When you help a patient overcome hesitation, you aren't just filling a slot—you're ensuring they get the care they need.

name: Treatment Communication
description: Clearly and confidently answers basic patient questions about routine treatments and procedures. When faced with questions beyond their knowledge, proactively ensures patients receive accurate information by providing appropriate resources or referring them to the correct team member, such as the treatment coordinator or dentist, to address their concerns fully
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you answering routine treatment questions or handing off when needed?”
friendly_description: You clarify the complex. Answering questions with confidence (or knowing when to grab the doctor) empowers patients to move forward with trust.

name: Establishing Credibility
description: Builds patient trust by effectively communicating the practice's and dentists' expertise, experience, and commitment to quality care. Highlights qualifications, advanced technologies, or accolades to reassure patients of the high standard of treatment they will receive.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in highlighting our dentists’ expertise to reassure patients?”
tagline: Make sure they know we are the best
friendly_description: You are the team's biggest fan. When you highlight our doctors' expertise, you give patients the peace of mind that they are in the best hands.

name: Facilitating Smooth Processes
description: Quickly and confidently provides patients and guardians with all necessary resources, documentation, and materials in a timely manner. Ensures the process for scheduling and undergoing treatment is as smooth and efficient as possible, enhancing patient satisfaction and promoting follow-through with recommended care.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you in providing all forms/info promptly so treatment flows easily?”
tagline: Creating Magic - make it a magical experience
friendly_description: You make the logistics invisible. By handling the paperwork and details effortlessly, you let the patient focus entirely on their health and happiness.

name: Sterilization and Procedure Preparation
description: Ensures that all equipment, instruments, and treatment rooms are thoroughly sterilized, properly stocked, and correctly set up for each specific procedure. Follows established protocols to maintain a safe and efficient clinical environment.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you that rooms, instruments, and supplies are fully prepped and sterile for every procedure?”
friendly_description: Safety starts with you. By maintaining a pristine clinical environment, you protect every patient and set the stage for flawless procedures.

name: Mastery of Dental Procedures
description: Demonstrates exceptional knowledge and skill in performing all dental procedures, both independently and when assisting the dentist. Ensures each step is executed with precision and appropriate timing to deliver high-quality patient care.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you performing or assisting procedures with precise timing and skill?”
friendly_description: You are the dentist's right hand. Executing procedures with precision and anticipating needs makes the appointment smoother for everyone.

name: Accurate Charting
description: Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of dental terminology, oral anatomy, and practice management software to accurately and thoroughly record patient information and complete clinical notes in order to convert dentist verbal instructions into accurate charting and treatment planning.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in converting dentist instructions into complete, correct chart notes?”
friendly_description: You write the history of their care. Accurate, professional charting ensures that every future decision is based on the full picture.

name: Patient Comfort and Communication During Procedures
description: Continuously centers the patient's experience throughout dental procedures by actively monitoring their comfort level, understanding, and emotional state. Maintains open communication with the patient, providing reassurance, explaining steps when appropriate, and promptly addressing any signs of pain, discomfort, or fear. By prioritizing patient comfort and engagement during treatment, reduces interruptions and enhances clinical outcomes.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you keeping patients informed and at ease throughout procedures?”
friendly_description: You are the patient's advocate in the chair. Monitoring their comfort and easing their fears turns a scary appointment into a safe one.

name: Office Task Management
description: Effectively handles non-clinical administrative tasks such as inventory management, ordering supplies, and coordinating equipment maintenance. Contributes to a well-organized and smoothly functioning dental practice by completing administrative duties accurately and on time.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you managing inventory, orders, and equipment maintenance on time?”
friendly_description: A great practice runs on details. Managing inventory and equipment behind the scenes guarantees the clinical team never has to hit pause.

name: Coordinating Patient Flow
description: Ensures a seamless flow of patients through the practice by efficiently coordinating with the dental team and front office staff. Minimizes wait times and enhances the patient experience by effectively managing appointment schedules and promptly addressing any delays or scheduling conflicts.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you coordinating with the team to keep patients moving smoothly?”
friendly_description: You keep the rhythm of the back office going. Coordinating with the front desk minimizes wait times and respects everyone's schedule.

name: Patient Record Management
description: Maintains accurate, up-to-date patient records by applying knowledge of record-keeping protocols and confidentiality requirements. Ensures all documentation—including medical histories, treatment notes, and consent forms—is completed correctly and securely, complying with legal and ethical standards.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you maintaining thorough, secure patient records?”
friendly_description: Accuracy is your hallmark. Maintaining airtight patient records protects the practice and ensures the highest standard of care continuity.

name: Clerical Procedure Requirements
description: Ensures that all clerical tasks related to patient procedures—such as obtaining consent forms, verifying insurance information, and scheduling follow-up appointments—are completed accurately and promptly. Collaborates with the clinical team to support seamless patient care through clear communication and timely documentation.
interview_prompt: How consistently do you ensure that consent forms are signed, the guardian is authorized, and xrays are properly labelled?
friendly_description: You close the loop on care. Handling consents and follow-ups promptly means the patient's journey is complete and compliant.

name: Empathetic Practice Policy Education
description: Effectively communicates and enforces practice policies in a firm yet empathetic manner. Educates patients on procedures like timely check-in, appointment arrivals, cancellations, and rescheduling without causing frustration or anger, ensuring understanding and cooperation.
interview_prompt: How consistently do you emphasize the importance of keeping appointments and ask for Google reviews after every appointment?
friendly_description: You guide patients with kindness. Helping them understand our policies prevents frustration and keeps the relationship positive.

name: Demonstrating Emotional Intelligence
description: Exhibits high emotional intelligence by effectively managing personal emotions and recognizing and responding appropriately to the emotions of patients and colleagues. Fosters positive interactions and a supportive environment within the practice.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you recognizing and responding to patient and team emotions effectively?”
friendly_description: You read the room perfectly. Managing emotions—yours and theirs—creates a supportive atmosphere where everyone feels safe.

name: Trust Building Interactions
description: Builds genuine connections with patients through personalized interactions. Makes patients feel known and appreciated by remembering details, addressing their individual needs, and maintaining professionalism, thereby fostering trust and a sense of being truly cared for.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in building genuine connections that foster trust?”
friendly_description: You are the face of care. Remembering personal details and treating patients like friends builds a trust that keeps them coming back.

name: Handling Constructive Feedback
description: Responds to patient complaints or negative feedback calmly and professionally. Addresses concerns appropriately, seeking mutually beneficial solutions to enhance patient satisfaction and improve practice services.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you turning complaints into positive outcomes?”
friendly_description: You listen to understand. Responding to concerns with calm professionalism turns a moment of friction into a moment of connection.

name: Effective Objection Handling
description: Skillfully addresses patient objections to recommended treatments—such as concerns about cost, urgency, or convenience—by reinforcing the clinical necessity and benefits. Helps patients understand why the treatment is important for their health.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you addressing patient objections to recommended treatments?”
friendly_description: You help them see the value. When you gently address a concern about treatment, you act as a partner in their long-term health.

name: Clear Treatment Communication
description: Clearly, concisely, and confidently explains all aspects of treatment options and plans to patients, ensuring they fully understand the procedures, benefits, and what to expect.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you explaining treatment plans so patients fully understand?”
friendly_description: You make the complex simple. Explaining treatment in plain language removes fear and empowers patients to take ownership of their smile.

name: Establishing Credibility
description: Builds patient trust by effectively communicating the practice's and dentists' expertise, experience, and commitment to quality care. Highlights qualifications, advanced technologies, or accolades to reassure patients of the high standard of treatment they will receive.
interview_prompt: “How confident are you in communicating our practice’s expertise and technology advantages?”
friendly_description: You validate their choice. Reminding patients of the team's expertise reassures them that they are receiving world-class care.

name: Empowering Informed Decisions
description: Provides comprehensive information about the clinical need for recommended treatments and the potential risks of delaying care, enabling patients to make fully informed decisions about their oral health without feeling pressured.
interview_prompt: “How comfortable are you explaining health risks of delay to support informed choices?”
friendly_description: You empower action. By clearly outlining the "why" behind the treatment, you help patients make the best decision for their future without feeling pressured.

name: Team Training Oversight
friendly_description: You make sure clinical staff stay on track with trainings, certifications, and growth plans—so no one falls behind and everyone keeps improving.

name: Patient Care Standards
friendly_description: You confirm that every patient-facing step—from intake to post-op—runs consistently, and you step in fast when something drifts off course.

name: Compliance and Safety
friendly_description: You own the behind-the-scenes systems that keep the practice safe and compliant—checking, correcting, and staying ahead of issues before they become problems.

name: Operational Efficiency
tagline: Find waste, fix it, scale it
friendly_description: You review what's working and what's leaking—then test changes and lock in the wins that protect both revenue and the patient experience.

name: Schedule and Flow
friendly_description: You actively manage the schedule, staffing, and room flow so patients move through smoothly—minimizing waits, confusion, and bottlenecks.

name: Root Cause Analysis
friendly_description: You use data and patterns to dig past surface issues, find the real cause, and lead changes that stop problems from repeating.

name: Revenue Cycle Management
friendly_description: You own the money pipeline—making sure claims, collections, and follow-ups happen consistently so the practice stays financially strong.

name: Leading and Coaching
friendly_description: You set clear expectations, run effective huddles and 1:1s, give real-time feedback, and coach your team toward both growth and results.

name: Trust Building
friendly_description: You build trust with families by doing what you say, explaining things clearly, and handling problems with transparency and care.

name: Emotional Intelligence
friendly_description: You stay calm under pressure, pick up on emotional cues from staff and parents, and respond in ways that de-escalate and stabilize.

name: Community and Marketing
friendly_description: You support org-level marketing, help the team show up at community events, and nurture relationships with referral partners.

name: Case Communication
friendly_description: You ensure the team presents treatment clearly and consistently—so parents understand, trust, and feel confident moving forward.

name: Financial Coordination
friendly_description: You make sure families get accurate estimates, verified benefits, and clear payment options—so finances support rather than block care.

name: Treatment Plan Follow-Up
friendly_description: You maintain systems that track unscheduled or incomplete treatment and drive timely follow-up so important care doesn't fall through the cracks.

name: Patient Experience
tagline: Design the feeling of the visit
friendly_description: You shape the overall feel of every visit—environment, small touches, communication—based on feedback and observation, always refining.

tagline: Accurate records protect patients and teams
